findings.initial_problem: Role association worked only when label and value appeared in the same line.
findings.limits: Unique bounded neighbor from same source/page or consecutive OCR text; ambiguous cells abstain. Spatial heuristics still need independent layout qualification.

findings.initial_problem: Only 21 of 96 declared fields had executable type checks.
findings.limits: 89 fields now have basic format/checksum checks. Seven composite/versioned fields remain deliberately not_checked. Format validation never proves correct transcription or document authenticity.

findings.initial_problem: Qwen did not receive the raw line graph or approved strategies promised by the architecture.
findings.limits: No geometry is invented for lines of a whole-page OCR string.

findings.initial_problem: The compiler accepted trusted conditions, but runtime had no source for them; all full profiles had unresolved conditions.
findings.limits: No conditions inferred from missing OCR or client flags. A fixed service/document-version contract requires explicit expert-attested configuration.

findings.initial_problem: F04/F05/F09 were generic callback libraries with no trace/model-stage adapters.
findings.limits: No real-model diagnostic effect has been measured. Vision remains an explicit adapter gap.

findings.initial_problem: Generic XML was parsed without version-specific field mapping; a trusted-record connector did not exist.
findings.limits: No MChD/XSD/signature support is claimed. Versioned native schemas and an authorized connector are separate work.

findings.initial_problem: No Linux/GPU acceptance or independent field-quality qualification existed.
findings.limits: Software tests cannot substitute for Docker build, real RTX execution, VRAM/p95 measurements or held-out documents.
